summary:
MARSIGHT is an AI-powered smart helmet assistant designed to support future astronauts during Mars exploration missions. The system combines NASA Mars data, artificial intelligence, augmented reality, health monitoring, hazard detection, and intelligent navigation to help astronauts make safer and more informed decisions in real time.

Mars explorers will face challenging terrain, limited resources, and communication delays with Earth. MARSIGHT addresses these challenges by providing route optimization, environmental analysis, mission planning, health monitoring, and real-time guidance directly through a smart helmet interface.

Using Mars terrain maps, geological mapping data, and real surface imagery from NASA resources, MARSIGHT transforms complex planetary data into clear and actionable insights. The system helps astronauts avoid hazards, identify scientific points of interest, optimize exploration routes, and improve mission safety and efficiency.

Our goal is to make future human exploration of Mars safer, smarter, and more effective.
details:
MARSIGHT is an AI-powered smart helmet assistant designed to support future astronauts during Mars exploration missions. The project addresses one of the major challenges of human exploration on Mars: navigating unfamiliar terrain, avoiding hazards, and making critical decisions while facing communication delays with Earth.

The system combines NASA Mars data, artificial intelligence, augmented reality, health monitoring, hazard detection, and intelligent navigation into a single wearable solution. Through the helmet interface, astronauts receive real-time route guidance, terrain analysis, mission recommendations, hazard alerts, oxygen monitoring, and health status updates directly within their field of view.

MARSIGHT uses resources such as NASA's Mars Trek, planetary geologic mapping data, and Perseverance rover imagery to improve situational awareness and support safer exploration. The system can also simulate mission routes before deployment, helping astronauts select safer and more efficient paths.

The main benefit of MARSIGHT is transforming complex Mars data into clear and actionable guidance that improves safety, efficiency, and decision-making during exploration missions. Unlike traditional navigation systems, MARSIGHT integrates navigation, health monitoring, environmental awareness, and AI assistance into one intelligent platform.

To develop the concept, we used NASA open data resources, artificial intelligence concepts, augmented reality concepts, Microsoft Copilot, research, and prototyping tools. Our project is creative because it focuses on creating an intelligent mission companion rather than just a map, helping astronauts actively respond to challenges in real time while exploring Mars.
